title: Densofi
tagline: Unlocking price discovery and liquidity for domain names utilizing DNS, ENS, NFT, SuperchainERC20
description:
Unlocking price discovery and liquidity for domain names. 
Domain names lack price discovery and utility. 
We allow dns records (RWA) to be brought onchain and converted to liquid erc20 shares. Allowing speculation, early liquidity provisioning, utility use cases, and defi integration for 2+B$ domain name industry.
how_its_made:
DNS entries -> verified via txt records inline with ENS gasless DNSSEC integration -> mints an erc1155 nft on chain -> mints SuperChainERC20 to user to allow cross chain use. 
ERC20 -> liquidity pools on uni/1inch for defi integration. 
Using optimism superChainERC20, worldcoin,  starterkit, forge, OZ. 
Frontend built w/ nextjs, react, wagmi, ensjs
